# cubepath_ssh_key (Resource)

Manages an SSH key on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the SSH key.
- `public_key` (String, Sensitive) The SSH public key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the SSH key was created.
- `fingerprint` (String) The fingerprint of the SSH key.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the SSH key.
- `key_type` (String) The type of the SSH key (e.g., ssh-rsa, ssh-ed25519).
